digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter family (Cloud and Data Center)
propositions: GitHub PR #120 proposed a second Jira adapter that forks private field-mapping and sanitization logic from the Cloud adapter, creating uncontrolled duplication of six symbols with no contract governing what is shared.

Three independent copies of the local-to-Jira status and priority maps exist in adapters/jira/jira_fields.py, adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py, and rebar_reconciler/config.py; they have drifted (the jira_fields copy omits deleted→Done, producing an invalid Deleted state).

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) are loaded by path via dynamic loaders and cannot be relocated without breaking the loader, yet some shared logic resides in them.

Self-hosted Jira Data Center differs from Cloud on three axes: REST v2 with wiki/plain-text instead of ADF, PAT bearer auth instead of ACLI subprocess, and name-based instead of accountId user identity; a single shared backend port must accommodate both via injected contracts.

The DC connection must enforce HTTPS by default, reject non-TLS URLs unless explicitly overridden with a warning, never disable certificate verification, and require the PAT via environment variable only (never from committed config).

The probe classifier hardcodes Cloud workflow state names {Resolved, Done, Cancelled} but DC may use different resolved-state names, causing misclassification if shared verbatim; it must accept the names as a parameter.
